title: The Cutting Board
description:
Place a **Cutting Board**, put an item on it with right-click, then hit it with the right tool.

A **knife** breaks food into parts — one chicken becomes two chicken cuts, one cow's worth of beef becomes minced beef. More portions from the same animal.

An **axe** strips logs. **Shears** cut wool into string — worth knowing, since nothing drops string in this pack.

*Hover an item in JEI and press U to see if it can be cut.*
